en:
At least, delicious enough to lure <font_kind=yakuza_italic>me</font_kind>
out to a backwater town like this.

Gorchov-san here's a real octopus aficionado,
so the rumors did good t'draw him in.

Even so... I can't go out and catch them
if you're sitting here injured like this!

Isn't there any way you can help me!?
I'll do anything!

I told ya, it ain't happenin'!
They're jus' too dangerous fer me.

I'm actually kinda interested.
I'll catch this octopus for you.
Huh? <font_kind=yakuza_italic>Yer</font_kind> gonna do it?

Yeah, I've become used to fishing lately.
And I'm interested in that tasty octopus.
But it's a dangerous creature. Will you be okay?

I understand the risk. I've been in some pretty
dangerous situations, I'm prepared for whatever happens.

Besides, I caught a large squid last time. If I can catch
a squid, an octopus shouldn't be much harder. Right?

I don't know if that's true, but...
If you're so sure, you can go on n' try.
Please, I'm depending on you!

Yeah. But I don't work for free.
You said you'd do anything, right?

In that case, if I get that octopus for you,
you have to join my baseball team.

Does that work for you?
You're a superstar, right?

Y-Yes!
I'll gladly join you.
Great, then it's settled.
To think everything would work out like this...

Kay, I'll bring the ship 'round to the right spot.
Jus' talk to me when yer ready.

Oh, Kiryu-san.
Y'ready to head out?
Come talk t'me when ya wanna raise anchor.
Okay! I'll go prep the boat!

I'll be waiting here until that
legendary octopus arrives on my plate!
Wowww, that octopus really <font_kind=yakuza_italic>was</font_kind> delicious!

Yup, I was hopin' t'eat it again before I died,
n' I did thanks to Kiryu-san.

By the way Kiryu-san, here's your
payment for this haul. Nice work.
I'm so full!
Well? Satisfied now?

Yes, it was incredible!
This'll pump me up for next season!

Glad to hear it.
And our promise? You're keeping it?

Of course I am.
It'll be a good change of pace.
I'm ready to join your team, Kiryu-san!
Great, looking forward to it.

I've heard of catching fish with worms,
but catching baseball players with octopus...?

I don't really know Kiryu-san well,
but he's quite an unbelievable person.

Yup. I've been on this planet fer years,
but I ain't ever met a guy like him before.
He's a weird one, that Kiryu.
Yup. He certainly is.
Hey, what are you two talking about?

Y'know, jus' about how Amano-san's
got a huge crush on ya, Kiryu-san.

Wh-What're you talking about!?
That's not true!
Then why're ya blushin' so much?
You're the worst, Isao-san!

It was a close call this time... 
But don't give up, try again another time.

When you wanna go out to sea,
come talk to me.

I'm not too sure 'bout the sea's conditions right now.
Try comin' back another time.
I ain't doin' it!
But I'm begging you!
No means no!

What is it, you two?
Another argument?
Ah, Kiryu-san...

What's wrong this time?
Does the world's tastiest salmon live here, too?
It... came back.
The salmon?
No... It's a shark.

There's a huge man-eatin' terror that roams
'round these parts... The Bloody Shark.
The Bloody Shark...

Yup. It's a real frightenin' sight,
with rows o' teeth n' huge blood-red eyes.

It used t'wreak havoc 'round here years back,
but it disappeared... 'til lately, that is.

That thing's what wrecked my leg, too.
It's a monster.
Sounds like it...

I'm lucky t'have got off this easy, though.
Tons o' other fishermen fell victim to that thing.
Includin' Amano's old man.

Guy was one o' the best fishermen in town.
One o' my closest friends, too.

But one day, he met that monster out on the water.
N' that was the last we saw o' him...
That's horrible...

That's why... That's why I need to fight!
I have to avenge my father's death!

I'm begging you, Isao-san!
Take me to where this monster is!

Y'ain't goin' nowhere!
Yer never gonna win against that thing!

A girl like ya without a shred o' experience
would get swallowed whole out there!

Think o' how yer old man'd feel
if that happened to ya!
But... But...

I ain't lettin' up!
Enough's enough!
Hey!

Geez... That girl's even more
stubborn than her old man was.

What about this Bloody Shark?
Is it <font_kind=yakuza_italic>really</font_kind> that dangerous?

Yup, it's jus' like I told ya.
Scariest thing in the ocean, if ya ask me.

But... if we don't do somethin' fast,
we might have another victim on our hands.
S'pose all we can do is wait 'til it leaves...

Y'better stay outta the water too, Kiryu-san.
Thing's dangerous, y'hear?

No... I'm going. 
I'll chase that beast away.

Huh!?
Wait... Y'can't be serious!

I am. Who knows how many more fishermen
could fall victim to that monster if I don't.

And if that happened, even more kids
would end up just like Amano.

It hurts to lose a father... I understand that.
And I want to help others avoid that pain.

Besides, this thing took Amano's father from her.
She deserves a little bit of closure.
And for Amano, I'd gladly provide it.

Sheesh, yer a real charmer.
I'd fall fer ya if I was a woman...

A-Anyways!
C'mon, I'll take ya over t'that thing's lair.

It's leagues stronger than yer other opponents, though.
Make sure yer spear and yer mind're sharp first.

If ya died out there, Kiryu-san,
Amano'd have one more thing t'be sad about...
N' if that happened, I'd never forgive ya.
You really care for Amano, huh?

'Course I do! Anyways, I'll prep the boat
when yer good n' ready. Jus' lemme know.
Yo, Kiryu-san. Y'ready to head out?
Come talk to me if y'wanna set sail.

All right, let's get movin'!
Y'can do it, Kiryu-san!

I never shoulda doubted ya, Kiryu-san!
Y'kicked the stuffin' outta that thing!

Yer really somethin' else!
How 'bout a drink t'celebrate!?
Oh, Amano.

Listen t'this, Amano!
Kiryu-san got revenge fer yer old man!
Idiot!

Huh? Hey, what's 'at fer!?
Kiryu-san did this fer you!

You left without even saying goodbye...
I was so worried...

I thought you were gonna meet
the same end my father did, Kiryu-san...
I wouldn't die on you.

You should know by now...
I can handle anything the ocean throws at me.

Besides, Isao-san would never forgive me
if I made you sad again.

Enough of the tears now, okay?
Smiling suits you far better.

Mkay, we're done with the sobbin', then!
We took down that monster, after all!

It's time t'celebrate!
We gotta get ready, Amano!

Ahhh, I jus' love drinkin' with you two!
Ain't it great, Kiryu-san?

Oh, Kiryu-san!
This is your payment for today!

This is even more than usual.
Are you sure about this?

Darn tootin'.
The other fishermen pitched in.

Everyone's free t'fish again now that ya
speared that giant shark. This is yer thanks.

It's not much of a reward fer riskin' yer life,
but it's all fer you.
Got it. I'll gladly accept.

I ain't finished, though.
Ya've been a real lifesaver 'round here.
Lemme thank ya again, Kiryu-san.

It was nothing. I'm thankful
for all our time together, too.

Um... By the way, Kiryu-san...
how would you feel about fishing with us some more?

Yeah, c'mon!
Y'should stick around 'til I'm all healed up!

I appreciate the offer, but I really
don't know how long I'll be in this town.
There's something else I need to do.
Oh... I guess I'm not surprised.

This place means a lot to me, though.
I promise to keep coming back as long as I can.
That okay with you?

Y-Yes, of course it is!
Right, Isao-san!?

Y'don't even gotta ask.
We're gonna pull up some huge hauls, Kiryu-san!

Anyways, let's pull ourselves together
n' go fer another round!
Huh? I think I've had enough for today!

What're ya sayin'!?
Kiryu-san's never gonna go fer a lightweight like you!

G-Go for me...?
Wh-Wh-What're you talking about!? Geez!

Ya did good out there. Amano ain't around,
so I'll be givin' ya yer reward today.
See ya next time.

Rumor has is another shark's been hangin' around...
Near identical t'the one from before.

Don't wanna pressure ya, but I was hopin'
y'could get rid o' this one, too.
Hey, don't make it sound so simple.

C'mon, it should be a piece o' cake fer ya!
Anyways, good luck out there!
Sheesh. Some friend you are...
Oh, that laughter's coming from the bar...

Come to think of it, I haven't gone
into a bar for laughs and drinks here...

Well, I guess I drank with Haruto at
Kiyomi's bar... But he was drinking milk.

Hm? What're ya doin' standing out
here gawkin' at the bar?

Oh, I get it, y'must be too nervous
to go in because it's your first time!
N-No, that's not it...

No need t'feel ashamed,
I was in your shoes once.

I remember peekin' in the door a bit
t'see what it was like inside...

Yer lookin' like a newcomer to
bar culture. That right?

I don't know if that's really a thing,
but yeah, I grew out of the bar scene.

Alrighty then! Fate musta sent ya
my way, then. I'll join ya. C'mon!
W-Wait, I never said I wanted to...

Now now, not another word. It's my treat. 
'Sides, a drink with Mama cures what ails ya!

Not t'mention drinking buddies.
Step on in.
Heh... Well, one glass wouldn't hurt.

That's the spirit! C'mon now!
No time like the present.
Hey Mama, I'm back!

Welcome back, Hatakeyama-san!
This a friend of yours?

He was peepin' inside, so I invited him in.
Um... Oh wait, I didn't catch yer name.
Oh, I'm Kazuma Kiryu.

Kiryu-san, eh?
I'm Hatakeyama.

Glad t'meetchya, Kiryu-san.
Welcome.

Tch, y'ain't welcome. I don't much
care fer strangers gettin' in my space.

Hey Kaneko-san. Don't be like that.
The bar's open to everyone.

W-Well, we have some fussy regulars, but
he'll warm up t'ya the more ya stop in.
That all it takes?

Let's just have a drink. I'll show ya
how t'enjoy yourself at a bar.

Oh, Mama, gimme the usual.
Make it double for Kiryu-san here.

Alrighty then, lemme give ya the
scoop on small town bar culture.

Hey, don't get too big fer yer
britches now.

I-I know that!
I'm doin' him a kindness here.

'Sides, if Kiryu-san becomes a regular,
it's your sales goin' up, ain't it Mama?

That's a fine point. Hatakeyama-san,
you tell him jus' how great we are, then.

Anyhow, bars are great for enjoying a drink
and a chat with all sortsa different folks.

Sometimes we even gather around
to have a long, lively conversation.
Huh, everyone's like family then...

Those talks are a right good time. Though
we usually talk about pretty dumb stuff.

Mhm, Kiryu-san, once you're friendly with
everyone, join in and liven up conversations.

O-Okay, got it.
I need to be friendly, huh...?

Oh, y'ain't worried about all this, are ya?
Don't be, everyone here's good at heart.

Exactly, don't sweat it. All the
regulars here have their particulars.
Right, Kaneko-san?
Oh, shut it.

Some day soon you'll fit right in
with us here, Kiryu-san.

My bar offers karaoke n' darts, too.
Nothin' beats those fer makin' friends.
Oh yeah, Gen-san loves his karaoke.
Doesn't he?
Heh, seems like a lively little place.
Yeah, 'cept most of us're all old men.

So all these older guys have their
eyes on the mama then?

Well, sure Mama's a pretty number,
but she don't put up with no tomfoolery.
Oh, y'see that sofa yonder?

The center seat is the throne of the
bar... A man has t'earn that seat.
Th-Throne...?

Yeah. Unless you're the king of regulars,
y'ain't allowed t'drink from that spot.

In other words, it means it's reserved
for the one true King of New Gaudi.
King of New Gaudi... Huh.

And, y'best known Mama's approval don't
come easy. She's a tough cookie to figure.

She's genuine and nice, but a right mystery.
She don't jus' open her heart to anyone...
Hatakeyama-san, I can hear every word!

Oh no, that's um, not my opinion.
Jus' word 'round the campfire...
So much fer my chance at the throne...

W-Well, Kiryu-san, if y'want to sit there,
y'best start gettin' friendly with folks.

Hmm, I see. Basically, I just need
to talk to all the customers.

That's right. If y'keep widening your
circle, only good'll come of it!

Like I said, all the regulars here are good folks.
They're there when you need them.

Heh... Is that so? Thanks for today.
I had a great time and a nice drink.
Let's drink again soon, Kiryu-san.

We'll be here fer ya, Kiryu-san.
And Hatakeyama-san, let's have some words.

The New Gaudi Bar, huh? Might be a nice
place to come in for a drink once in a while.

There's some real characters here.
Maybe I'll even make some friends.
I'll check back if I find the time.
S... Someone...
P-Please get me... something to eat...

He must be hungry...
I guess I could bring him something.
